build_detector3d_networks: build a 3D detector network by calling build_networks to construct VFE, backbone, and head modules
run_post_processing: run post_processing on batch_dict to apply NMS and generate final 3D bounding box predictions
load_detector_checkpoint: load model parameters from a checkpoint file using load_params_from_file with optional CPU fallback
load_detector_with_optimizer: load model and optimizer state from checkpoint files using load_params_with_optimizer to resume training
generate_recall_record: generate a recall record by computing 3D IoU between predicted boxes and ground truth boxes
